acceptance: One verified operation yields equivalent observable effects and UNKNOWN_COMMIT semantics in UI, REST, CLI, MCP.

positive.fixture: the same write on REST, interface client, CLI and MCP: identical category, effect, retry, state, digest and observed values; status agrees

negative.fixture: unknown commit and unverified effect equal on all four with one source attempt and a blocked follow-up; seven refusal and failure scenarios equal; an unknown commit on one surface blocks the others and any may reconcile it

security_and_source_permissions: Reconciliation settles only on source evidence; a matching state alone never does.
